name: Linux fleet HTTP audit
description: Ask a whole Linux fleet who is serving HTTP, where (host or Docker), and under which hostnames — three fleet-wide osquery sweeps, per-node probes for nginx config, TLS names and /etc/hosts, and one evidence row per web server written to Stage.

fleetTags.label: Fleet tags
fleetTags.description: osctrl tags selecting the Linux nodes to sweep (queryByTags).

flows.title: Linux fleet — HTTP / nginx + served hostnames audit
flows.description: Three parallel sweeps → per-node inventory → rule → four per-target probes → report → one Stage row per host.
